description: This Java class `HeaderValueValidator` performs validation checks on header values to ensure they conform to expected data types as defined by `HeaderDefinition`. It uses a chain of validators to validate different types such as integers, longs, booleans, JSON arrays, entity tags, and matchers. The class is singleton and deprecated in favor of newer validators.

classes.name: HeaderValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton class implementing BiConsumer that validates header values against multiple data types using a chain of validators. Deprecated since version 1.1.0.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HeaderValueValidator.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Performs validation on the provided header definition and character sequence by chaining multiple validators.
